snippet.title: [E11E Plays] Wanting Shock Demo by @GamerGirl-Studios
snippet.description:
After months of work, a fellow dev and friend of mine has finally released a playable demo for her large-scale project “Wanting Shock”, a story about a group of students coming together for a week to solve murder mysteries! 

Apart from some grammatical errors, I have zero complaints about the game itself, it was very enjoyable to play. I’m a fast reader so slow readers can pause. Anyways, it would probably be good to support her by downloading her demo and interacting with her dev logs and social media up until the full release! 

As for you @GamerGirl-Studios, keep up the good work and remember that always believing in yourself and putting your best foot forward is the best way to respect the efforts of the people that support you! As long as you don’t give up, you are making us proud!
